research_cards.mechanism: Weak deferred reduction: retain the existing 256-bit cswap but remove only the post-add/post-sub MSBS clean into the existing next fused cdouble fold. The fold then absorbs the wider 7f rather than 3f contribution within LSBS=53. The strong version that moves the entire fold across cswap is not included: it requires 257-bit swap operands and costs +256 full-price Toffoli per iteration per direction.

Q/STRIP: B0 peak exceeds 1,154 or stale/occupancy suppression erases the preliminary win.
LAMBDA: upper CI(delta lambda) >= +0.5; REFUTED immediately if mean classical >30 per 9,024-equivalent or a candidate round exceeds twice baseline maximum.
